title: Blinkr
tagline: Meet new friends with superpowers. Chat with people who care about your interests, powered by NFTs
description:
Blinkr addresses the challenge of connecting crypto enthusiasts and NFT collectors in a meaningful way by leveraging the information stored in their wallets.

**Links**
- [https://blinkr-five.vercel.app/](https://blinkr-five.vercel.app/)
how_its_made: During the development of Blinkr, we encountered several challenges that tested our team's resilience and problem-solving skills. Setting up PWA was a big issue, which was mitigated later.
